purpose: Test whether genuine two-way exchange of complete-model elites between the three HGS views creates endpoint improvement without increasing the formal search or complete-evaluation budgets.
control: Current archive-route-reuse MV-HGS-SP: one 5000-iteration HGS run per view, 24 complete archive candidates per view, then one time-limited route-pool recombination.
candidate: Two 2500-iteration HGS stages per view. Stage one completes 11 candidates per view; the eight best distinct complete-model solutions across all three views warm-start stage two in every view. Stage two completes 11 candidates per view. Both-stage routes enter the same time-limited route-pool recombination.
pass_rule: All six pairs feasible and budget-exact; candidate has zero strict losses and at least two strict wins against the current archive-route-reuse control.
stop_rule: If the pass rule fails, preserve HALT evidence and do not tune stages, elite count, panel, seed, or budgets on these observed cases.
claim_boundary: Development gate only. A pass permits a separately frozen confirmation and corrected E2 rerun; it is not formal evidence.
